name: Little Addons
teaser: This mod adds 3 new guns, 2 new calibers, 1 new helmets and 1 new Stim.
description_html:
REQUIRES CUSTOM QUESTS by TRAP

I’m working a lot, so it will take me a while to update/fix my mods

First, thanks TRON and his tutorial on how to use the Escape From Tarkov SDK, and also thanks to KCH ARMORY and his mods: VKS VYKHLOP 12.7X55 SNIPER RIFLE, base bullet of this mod -> AR-50 .50 BEOWULF.

Thanks to Jehree and Kobrakon with the client mod tutorials

Installation:

First Install CUSTOM QUESTS

After that install Little Addons

The Additions:

**Weapons:

Glock 21 - Basically the glock 17 chambered in .45 ACP (Mechanic LL2/LL3)

Colt M4 chambered in .50 Beowulf - It’s not .50 BMG (Mechanic LL3).

MP-700 .700 Nitro Express - Be careful the recoil can damage you and your enemy (Jaeger LL4).

VKS Vykhlop 12.7x55 Sniper Rifle - Big boy Ash-12 (Prapor LL3/LL4).

Ammo:

STs-130:

STs-130 12.7x55 Cartridge - Standard bullet for the VKS. Damage: 125 | Penetration: 35

STs-130VPS 12.7x55 Cartridge - increased penetration (expect HUGE bullet drop). Damage: 100 | Penetration: 67

STs-130PT2 12.7x55 Cartridge - increased accuracy (expect BIG bullet drop). Damage: 110 | Penetration: 42

the Ash-12 and the RSh-12 would not be able to feed or chamber rounds designed for the VKS due to significant length differences in the bullet component

.50 Beowulf:

.50 Beowulf HP- Hollow point bullet. Damage: 125 | Penetration: 8

.50 Beowulf FMJ- Standart bullet. Damage: 100 | Penetration: 28

.50 Beowulf Hydra-Shok JHP- Hollow point bullet with a tip. Damage: 115 | Penetration: 14

Helmets:

Rusty Bucket - A bucket to protect you from many bullets.

Quests:

Hunter’s Dreams -Little questline with Jaeger, begins with PMC level 10 (i will update this later with more quests )

Credits:

Rusty Bucket by Thunder
